## Air

---


[__Block Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/block_condition_types/air)

Checks if the block is air/void air/cave air.

Type ID: `eggolib:air`

---

### Examples

``` json
"block_condition": {
    "type": "eggolib:air"
}
```
